fields.label: Start date
fields.name: start_date
fields.instructions: First day of the retreat. Leave both dates empty for a waitlist retreat (no dates yet). Retreats are listed on the site in date order.

fields.label: End date
fields.name: end_date
fields.instructions: Last day of the retreat.

fields.label: Nights
fields.name: nights
fields.instructions: Number of nights, e.g. 6. Used in the page description.

fields.label: Location
fields.name: location_id
fields.instructions: The destination page this retreat belongs to. Cards, menus and the location page use it. Type to search. Required.

fields.label: Place line under the title
fields.name: location_label
fields.instructions: Optional. The place as the hero shows it, e.g. "Marrakech & Essaouira, Morocco". Leave empty to use the location's display name.

fields.label: Teachers
fields.name: teacher_ids
fields.instructions: The teachers who lead this retreat, in the order you want them shown. Search on the left, click to add; drag to reorder.

fields.label: Facilitators
fields.name: facilitator_ids
fields.instructions: YAWW hosts on the trip. They appear in the hosts tabs next to the teachers. Search on the left, click to add.

fields.label: Collection
fields.name: collection
fields.instructions: Signature Collection or Deep Dives. Sets the label on the card and which collection page lists the retreat.

fields.label: Booking status
fields.name: status
fields.instructions: What the badge on the card says. "Spaces left" uses the number below. "Waitlist" is for a retreat with no dates yet. Required.

fields.label: Spaces left
fields.name: spaces_left
fields.instructions: Only used when the status is "Spaces left", e.g. 3 shows "3 spaces left".

fields.label: WeTravel booking link
fields.name: wetravel_url
fields.instructions: The WeTravel trip page. Every "Reserve" and "Book now" button on this retreat opens it.

fields.label: Waitlist note
fields.name: waitlist_note
fields.instructions: Only for waitlist retreats: the sentence above the waitlist form, e.g. when the last edition ran.

fields.label: Subtitle
fields.name: subtitle
fields.instructions: One short line under the retreat name on the page, e.g. "A Yoga & Culture Retreat".

fields.label: About this retreat
fields.name: about
fields.instructions: The introduction under the hero, in the "About" section. One paragraph per block of text; press Enter twice between paragraphs. Bold and links are fine.

fields.label: Hero photo
fields.name: hero_image
fields.instructions: The large photo at the top of the page (also used when the page is shared). Use a wide landscape photo.

fields.label: Card photo
fields.name: card_image
fields.instructions: The portrait photo on retreat cards (312 x 408). Upload it at double size (624 x 816) for sharp screens.

fields.label: What's included: background photo
fields.name: includes_image
fields.instructions: Optional. The photo behind the "What's included" band. Empty = the default photo.

fields.label: Included
fields.name: includes
fields.instructions: One item per row, as shown in the "Included" list.

fields.label: Not included
fields.name: not_included
fields.instructions: One item per row, as shown in the "Not included" list.

fields.label: Footnotes
fields.name: includes_notes
fields.instructions: Optional small print under the lists, one note per row.

fields.label: Itinerary
fields.name: itinerary
fields.instructions: One row per day (or group of days), in order.

sub_fields.label: Photos
sub_fields.name: images
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. One or two photos for the day.

fields.label: Itinerary notes
fields.name: itinerary_notes
fields.instructions: Optional notes shown under the itinerary, one per row.

fields.label: Stay description (no hotel names)
fields.name: hotel_label
fields.instructions: A generic description such as "boutique hotel in Chiang Mai". Never write a hotel's name here (Utopia is the only exception).

fields.label: Accommodations
fields.name: stays
fields.instructions: One row per place you stay. Each row becomes a tab with its photos. Never use hotel names (except Utopia).

sub_fields.label: Name
sub_fields.name: name
sub_fields.instructions: Generic label, never a hotel name (except Utopia).

sub_fields.label: Tab label
sub_fields.name: tab
sub_fields.instructions: Short text for the tab. Empty = the name.

fields.label: Room venues
fields.name: room_venues
fields.instructions: Only for retreats with more than one stay: the venue names, in order, used to group the rooms. Same wording as the Accommodations rows.

fields.label: Rooms and prices
fields.name: rooms
fields.instructions: One row per room option, cheapest first. The price is per person in USD.

sub_fields.label: Venue
sub_fields.name: hotel_label
sub_fields.instructions: Only for retreats with several stays: one of the Room venues. Never a hotel name.

fields.label: Deposit (USD)
fields.name: deposit_usd
fields.instructions: Deposit per person shown in "How to book", e.g. 500.

fields.label: Balance due (days before)
fields.name: balance_due_days
fields.instructions: How many days before the start the balance is due, e.g. 90.

fields.label: Roommate note
fields.name: roommate_note
fields.instructions: Optional text about shared rooms and roommate matching.

fields.label: Optional extras
fields.name: extras
fields.instructions: Add-ons guests can book (massages, excursions...). One row per extra; each becomes a tab.

sub_fields.label: Tab label
sub_fields.name: tab
sub_fields.instructions: Short text for the tab. Empty = the name.

sub_fields.label: Price in USD
sub_fields.name: price_usd
sub_fields.instructions: Optional number, used when "Price as shown" is empty.

fields.label: Gallery title
fields.name: gallery_title
fields.instructions: Optional. Empty = "Where you'll be".

fields.label: Gallery intro
fields.name: gallery_intro
fields.instructions: Optional line under the gallery title. Empty = "Photographs from past retreats in ."

fields.label: Gallery photos
fields.name: gallery
fields.instructions: Photos for the slider, in order. Drag to reorder.

fields.label: Guest quotes
fields.name: testimonials
fields.instructions: The "What guests say" quotes. Only real reviews, copied word for word.

fields.label: Travel tips
fields.name: travel_tips
fields.instructions: Groups of tips (getting there, what to pack...). Empty = the location's travel tips.

fields.label: Additional info (FAQ)
fields.name: faqs
fields.instructions: Questions and answers shown at the bottom of the page.

fields.label: Search description
fields.name: seo_description
fields.instructions: Optional. The text Google shows under the title (about 150 characters). Empty = written automatically from the dates, place and teachers.
